tickets.title: US005: Audit Logging for Overrides
tickets.description:
As an IT Security Officer, I want the system to automatically log every manual prerequisite override with a timestamp and advisor ID, so that we maintain a secure and compliant audit trail.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: Every successful override generates an immutable log entry in the security database.
2. Pass/Fail: The log entry strictly contains the Timestamp, Student ID, Advisor ID, and Course Code.
